## Direction

The owner accepts the `r0.7` baseline-relative, profile/domain-aware
architecture as the basis for one targeted Stage A repair. The repair must:

- return a genuinely focused, exact-byte-bound ODQ-001F subset without
  AppleDouble metadata;
- bind final approval to the complete repaired architecture rather than a
  short sentence;
- separate method, claim, evidence, and qualification-decision identities;
- state the complete scientific-framework-to-production claim-layer sequence;
- prevent qualification-set access and candidate-selection overfitting;
- define the sampling unit, dependence, pairing, and inference target;
- retain every paired success, rescue, regression, joint failure, unavailable,
  known-inapplicable, and support-change state;
- prohibit truth-, historical-output-, future-iteration-, and final-quality-
  driven operational stopping;
- repair ratio, weighting, dispersion, nuisance-coupling, and time-to-quality
  metric edge cases;
- separate historical scientific-control, compatibility-candidate, and
  authorized-operational-fallback roles; and
- use generic recovery-regime profile identities while leaving downstream OOF
  and SZE inference outside FRUIT authority.

The exact final candidate must state that ODQ-001F approval selects only a
development and qualification architecture. It does not select ODQ-001 or
ODQ-001A–D semantics, a parent route, a numerical method, or a lane launch.

## Preserved Architecture

The direction preserves exact historical Citlali as paired control rather than
truth; baseline-relative noninferiority plus material improvement; separate
absolute truth/null and paired contrasts; Pareto comparison without a scalar
default; development/qualification/challenge separation; prospective freeze;
tail/stratum/failure/catastrophic safeguards; tuning/adaptation/override
distinctions; deterministic replay/restart; fixed-state versus complete-
procedure response/uncertainty; the implementation-informed / implementation-
blind firewall; downstream OOF/SZE ownership; and every prior nonauthorization.

## Explicit Nonauthorization

This direction does not close ODQ-001F, inspect or change implementation,
select a recurrence, parent route, profile, population, metric, threshold,
policy, stopping rule, or method, launch the empirical lane, open qualification
data, prototype or benchmark, dispatch Stage B, validate achieved performance,
assert readiness, change production, or authorize Unity work.
